title: First-claim checklist raises claim submissions
body:
### Hypothesis

If new claimants see the first-claim checklist, the share who submit a claim rises from 0.10 to 0.12.

### Metric

claim_submitted

### Baseline

0.10 conversion to claim_submitted over the 28 days before 2026-10-12, from PostHog

### Flag

first-claim-checklist

### Minimum sample

3841 per arm; two-sided two-proportion z-test, alpha 0.05, power 0.8, baseline rate 0.10, detectable rate 0.12
